title: Etapy wdrożenia KSeF 2.0 - KSeF (Krajowy System e-Faktur)
content:
Query: KSeF rachunkowość 2026
Source: https://ksef.podatki.gov.pl/etapy-wdrozenia-ksef/
Tier: official
Discovery confidence: 0.95
Summary for query "KSeF rachunkowość 2026":
- KSeF 2.0 rollout timeline:
- 1 Feb 2026: KSeF 2.0 becomes available for large businesses and those receiving invoices; KSeF 1.0 will be permanently disabled.
- 26–31 Jan 2026: Production environment downtime for KSeF 1.0 (including MCU) to complete transition; during downtime, basic permissions requests use form ZAW-FA.
- 1 Apr 2026: KSeF 2.0 becomes mandatory for all remaining enterprises not previously exempt, with general applicability.
- 1 Jan 2027: KSeF 2.0 becomes mandatory for all, including those previously exempt (micro firms with monthly sales ≤ 10,000 PLN documented by invoices remain exempt only until then?). Expect ongoing enforcement.
- What this means for accounting/finance:
- From Feb 2026, large entities and those issuing/receiving invoices should use KSeF 2.0.
